verdict.rationale: Calendly's own scheduling page says users can "fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits" so they "only get booked when you want to be." That covers buffers and daily booking caps, but only through a brief marketing mention. A community request for limiting total booked hours per day concerns a different, hours-based cap and does not contradict daily limits. Missing for 10: any evidence for minimum-notice settings, any evidence for date-range booking windows, explicit confirmation that buffers apply both before and after meetings, and detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of these controls.
